summary: All prompt elements present and verbatim: title 'The Deep Ocean: Earth's Last Frontier', 'Dr. Maya Chen', 'Marine Biology Dept.' — no invented text. Dark navy gradient aesthetic honored; three layered SVG wave paths pinned to the bottom 180px render cleanly with no stray artifacts, seams, or edge gaps (paths extend past the viewBox on both sides). Title block is horizontally centered (120px symmetric margins) and stacks title / divider / speaker / dept as expected. No overflow (scroll 1280x720, overflows=false), no clipping, no overlap between text and the wave graphic. Contrast is strong for all three text colors on the dark background and the smallest text is 24px, above the ~20px presentation floor. t0/t2/t5 are byte-identical, correct for a static slide, and console.log is empty.
